profile.headline: Engineer, educator, and researcher working where business, engineering, and AI meet
profile.bio: I spent years as a high-tech engineer in advanced manufacturing before moving into business education. Today I teach business analytics and research methods, lead student capstone projects, and research how AI is reshaping business and engineering practice. I believe the hardest and most interesting problems now sit between disciplines.
profile.bio2: This site is my working window into three areas: student experiential learning projects built on real business problems; AI Watch, a curated list of impactful AI videos, articles, and papers; and Diamond Market Watch, a biweekly tracker of natural and lab-grown diamond prices.
profile.statement: Built on real-world data and live business scenarios, these student projects train the judgment textbooks can’t, and several led to public presentations and showcases.

projects.title: Bridging the AI Skills Gap
